title: Window opened without a later Close Window
description: Error-prone rule — a step opens a new window (New Window, or Go to Related Record with the New-window option) and no Close Window follows anywhere later in the same script. Each execution leaks one window; in loops the leak multiplies, and on FileMaker Server a leaked window can silently replace the found set of the calling context.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A window opened per call and never closed accumulates — especially when the script runs once per record in a loop. This check is a heuristic: a callee may close the window, and a Close Window somewhere in the script does not prove every exit path reaches it.
rule.remediation: Close the window in the same script where it goes out of scope — name the window at the opening step and close it by that name on every exit path (including error branches before Exit Script).
